thread:
marta: quick sync  after the canary run we still don't have alignment on reclamation_grace and compaction triggers for host-backed pages. canary showed lower avg lat but more long-term heap churn. need defaults we can ship for Hosted and sane knobs for Private.

alex: saw the canary graphs. reclaim_grace=100ms gave lowest p50 but the p999 moved up. reclaim_grace=400ms reduced churn but increased stall probability if the compactor can't keep up.

kai: can you paste the canary config? batch sizes / kv cache hit?

marta: canary metadata: model=llama-3b, qps=900, microbatch=8, avg_seq=128, kv_hit=72%. logs -> s3://redwood-perf/offload/canary-2026-03-21.

alex: proposal: make reclamation window adaptive with headroom based on recent GPU utilization and a frag_growth EWMA. rules: min 25ms, max 750ms, frag_threshold=0.12 (12% delta over baseline). ramp step = 1.2x per sample up/down, bounded by min/max.

devon: agree adaptive but add compaction_score that scheduler uses to prioritize background compaction. compaction_score = alpha * frag_growth + beta * (1 - gpu_util_pct) + gamma * backlog_pages. tune alpha/beta/gamma via telemetry.
kai: hotness policy: prefer "recent-touch" set (last 500ms) then fallback to decayed hot-score (decay window 4m). recent-touch to avoid evicting pages active across microbatches.
marta: API surface suggestion for Private YAML:

```yaml
reclamation_policy:
  mode: adaptive   # adaptive | fixed
  min_ms: 25
  max_ms: 750
  frag_threshold: 0.12
  ramp_factor: 1.2
compaction:
  enabled: true
  compaction_score_threshold: 0.4
  background_window_pct: 0.15  # fraction of idle window to use
hotness:
  recent_touch_ms: 500
  decay_minutes: 4
```

alex: telemetry we should emit (per sample): reclaim_window_ms, frag_pct_delta, frag_growth_ewma, compaction_score, gpu_util_pct, kv_hit_pct, background_compact_time_ms. we can use that to drive a short ML model later if needed.

devon: one practical: compactor must be schedulable on node-level when gpu_util < 60% and compaction_score > threshold. otherwise postpone. also add a soft cap on pages compacted per-minute to avoid IO spikes.

kai: for Private customers who want determinism, allow fixed mode that ignores adaptive hints. default Hosted=adaptive, Private=fixed=false so adaptive on by default.
marta: action items: (1) alex -> PR with config schema + telemetry (PR #3521), (2) kai/devon -> implement EWMA frag growth and compaction_score shim, (3) infra to add compactor scheduling rule to staging. target: canary next Thu.

ops-bot: canary deploy initiated: infra/canary/offload-heuristics v1 -> canary (job 10121).

alex: i'll land schema draft and a small agent that logs the telemetry fields.
devon: prototyping compaction_score with alpha=0.7 beta=0.2 gamma=0.1, will post numbers.
kai: no objections to defaults from my side.
marta: tagging @eng-runtime: if objections to defaults (min 25ms, max 750ms, frag_threshold=0.12) speak now. otherwise i'll fold into the RFC update later today. :thumbsup:
